title: The AI Query API lists the FoodMart cubes and describes a cube with semantic annotations, behind a login

criteria.then: GET /rest/saiku/api/ai/cubes lists the FoodMart Sales cube
GET /rest/saiku/api/ai/schema/foodmart/FoodMart/FoodMart/Sales describes the cube and its measures carry a description and synonyms
